# `DiskSpace`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

One-member delta reporting the used-storage percentage when it changes.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, CSpaceChecker::GetSpace @0x125ad0, CSpaceChecker::TimeUpdate @0x125cc0 (64-bit build); shape OBSERVED (2026-10-12) |

Broadcast to all retained sockets on TCP 4700 (channel I) after a successful storage-space read that yields a changed integer percentage with a positive total capacity; an identical percentage is suppressed. The periodic updater refreshes when no earlier read exists or more than 5000 ms have elapsed; save, record and refresh paths can force a read. The 5000 ms figure is a refresh condition, not a broadcast rate or rate cap. This is not the full storage-volume getter result. Family: custom; no state or error. APK consumers: the app event dispatcher; the app device service disk-space handler.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"DiskSpace"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `used_percent` | integer | yes | - | Used storage percentage of the current storage. Denominator and range are not established by observation. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, changed - Shape OBSERVED (2026-10-12); value invented:

```json
{"Event":"DiskSpace","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","used_percent":37}
```
